title: Missing RESEND_API_KEY soft-fails all branded sends with warn only
blast: Every apply/eligibility/employer receipt and admin alert becomes a no-op on a misconfigured deploy; UX copy still promises an automatic email.
evidence: lib/email.ts getResend() returns null when process.env.RESEND_API_KEY unset; sendApplicationConfirmationEmail and peers console.warn and return { ok: false } without throwing. docs/EMAIL_SETUP.md documents the key. Confirmation page copy (messages/en.json confirmationHeroBody) promises automatic confirmation email.

title: Public /api/apply/confirmation-email requires recent Application row
blast: None for ship — open-relay vector already closed; leftover endpoint is rate-limited + application-anchored.
evidence: app/api/apply/confirmation-email/route.ts:59-69 findFirst Application where user.email matches and createdAt within 24h; else 400. Rate limits in lib/rate-limit.ts confirmationEmailRateLimiter + confirmationEmailEmailRateLimit.
